title: The Long Road West
description: You have walked the whole of the wold alone — vale, diggings, darkwood, and the high moor — and there is nothing left up here the sentry can set you to. So I have sent word ahead to Highkeep: the gryphon master at the roost has the Ashmoor lane off me now, and it is yours to ride. Take it west to the Sky Dock and ask for Warden Vale; the far country pays for hands the wold has outgrown.

objectives.desc: Fly the Ashmoor lane from the Highkeep roost to the Ashmoor Sky Dock
